items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow (same as prior), ruled out; X-rays negative for fracture, additional testing Monday; expected to miss time (previously ~1 month).
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on freak play bracing fall after trip; carted off.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota likely starts; major hit to WAS offense and fantasy assets tied to Daniels.
items.opportunity: Backup QB stream/Mariota upside; reduced WAS skill upside short-term.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury (non-contact), carted; scheduled for imaging Monday to determine extent.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring while scrambling in wet conditions; walking under own power postgame with slight limp, good spirits.
items.implication: Jeopardy for next game vs Eagles; Tyson Bagent would start if out.
items.opportunity: Bagent streamer; potential RB volume bump (Swift etc) if pass game limited; monitor CHI WRs/TE.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket possible); optimism confirmed.
items.why: RapSheet bullish tone; ETR projected in with docks.
items.implication: Playable with possible limited efficiency/snaps due to injury.
items.opportunity: Start if needed; monitor snaps/routes for docks impact.

items.text: RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); grab Jonah Coleman now as beneficiary.
items.why: Hamstring; ETR/Levitan expected look at Coleman.
items.implication: DEN RB committee opens; Coleman primary beneficiary for carries/role.
items.opportunity: Add/start Coleman handcuff/spot start; reverse if Harvey returns soon.

items.text: 49ers HC Shanahan: Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious; could have returned in Q4 if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.implication: Low miss risk; Robinson more concerning (high ankle).
items.opportunity: Evans hold/start; monitor Robinson for WR depth.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on Brock Bowers: “Close, very close. He looks great.” (was OUT knee Week 2).
items.implication: Imminent return boosts LV TE1/fantasy value ROS.
items.opportunity: Hold/start soon; stash if dropped; Jeanty synergy.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Caleb Williams (ham), Jayden Daniels (disloc elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Jonathon Brooks (groin), Rico Dowdle (toe), JK Dobbins (ham), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip minor), etc.
items.implication: Multiple RB/WR/TE/QB statuses pending imaging/updates; handcuffs elevate.
items.opportunity: Monitor Barkley (stinger Q return), Price, Reed, Brooks, Goedert for roles; beneficiaries if OUT.

items.implication: Monitor official; possible limited or sit.
items.opportunity: If out, LAR WR beneficiaries (Adams etc); if in, docks possible.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in w/ decent docks (Rap bullish); Puka true GTD; Olave clean no docks; Harvey->Jonah Coleman look; Pittman out->Germie Bernard look.
items.why: Status reports + tone; injury docks applied selectively.
items.opportunity: Coleman (Harvey out), Bernard (Pittman out) usage spikes; Puka monitor snaps.

items.text: Kenneth Walker as true workhorse is electric; league winner; opening up KC offense.
items.implication: RB1 upside in KC; hold/start confidently.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps; league-winner potential if sustained.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: 9/155/3 TDs; 5th WR ever with 8+ catches, 120+ yds, TD in each of first two games.
items.implication: Locked WR1/elite ROS; target share dominance.

items.text: Agrees stash Germie Bernard (YAC man, good McCarthy fit) with Pittman out; also deep stash notes.
items.why: Pittman OUT opens role; YAC fit.
items.implication: Deep league add for IND WR upside.

items.text: Chris Olave (hamstring) and Joe Burrow (back) EXPECTED TO PLAY; Olave clean.
items.why: Weekend reports; Levitan no docks Olave.
items.implication: Full or near roles; start confidently.
